Job Description: Data Scientist – Machine Learning & Optimization

**Experience:**
4–6 Years

**Location:**
Bangalore

**Work Mode:**
Hybrid

About CoffeeBeans Consulting

CoffeeBeans is a fast-growing technology company delivering high-quality software, data engineering, and AI solutions to clients across industries. We combine deep technical expertise with an agile mindset to solve complex business problems. Our teams work at the intersection of Data Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build intelligent, scalable, and business-focused solutions.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Data Scientist with strong expertise in Python, Machine Learning, Time-Series Modelling, and Numerical Optimization. The ideal candidate should have experience working with industrial or process-related data and developing predictive models to improve operational efficiency and optimize manufacturing processes.

The role involves reviewing and enhancing existing ML models, developing predictive solutions using historical and real-time industrial data, and applying constrained optimization techniques to identify optimal operating parameters. The candidate will also work closely with process engineers, plant operators, and domain experts to translate operational challenges into data-driven solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, evaluate, and improve Machine Learning models using Python for industrial and process-related applications.
* Work with algorithms such as LightGBM and Generalized Additive Models (GAM) for predictive modelling.
* Perform feature engineering, model validation, diagnostics, and explainability to improve model performance.
* Analyse time-series data, historical process data, sensor readings, equipment performance data, and laboratory data to build predictive models.
* Develop forecasting and predictive solutions using lagged features, process variables, and operational parameters.
* Apply numerical and constrained optimization techniques to identify optimal operating conditions.
* Work on multi-objective optimization problems involving throughput, recovery, production efficiency, and operational costs.
* Perform sensitivity analysis and scenario modelling to evaluate the impact of different operating parameters.
* Build and maintain ML pipelines, model inference workflows, and deployment processes.
* Perform live model validation and shadow testing by comparing model predictions against actual plant outcomes.
* Implement model monitoring and feedback mechanisms to ensure model reliability and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with process engineers, plant operators, and operational SMEs to understand business requirements and deliver practical solutions.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 4–6 years of hands-on experience in Python programming and Machine Learning.
* Strong experience in developing and improving ML models.
* Hands-on experience with LightGBM and Generalized Additive Models (GAM).
* Strong understanding of feature engineering, model validation, diagnostics, and model explainability.
* Experience in Time-Series Modelling, forecasting, and predictive analytics.
* Experience working with industrial process data, sensor data, historian data, or equipment performance data.
* Knowledge of numerical optimization, constrained optimization, and multi-objective optimization techniques.
* Experience with operating parameter optimization, sensitivity analysis, or scenario modelling.
* Understanding of ML pipelines, model deployment, inference workflows, and model monitoring.

Good to Have

* Experience in manufacturing, metals, mining, cement, chemicals, petrochemicals, oil & gas, power, or other process industries.
* Experience in manufacturing optimization, industrial process optimization, or production efficiency improvement.
* Familiarity with metaheuristic algorithms and optimization techniques.
* Experience with Kedro (QuantumBlack) or similar ML pipeline frameworks.
* Experience with API integration, live model testing, and shadow deployment.
* Experience working closely with process engineers, plant operators, and industrial domain experts.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who can combine strong Machine Learning fundamentals with practical industrial problem-solving skills. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with complex, time-dependent industrial datasets, improving existing predictive models, and applying optimization techniques to solve real-world manufacturing and operational challenges.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**
We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead.
  
  
Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!
  
  
**Overview**
The Product Manager owns the entire product lifecycle, from conceptualization to obsolescence, defining what to build by translating market and customer needs into solutions that deliver profitable growth and competitive differentiation. This role is responsible for developing product roadmaps, managing product P&L, and ensuring alignment with customer needs and market opportunities. The Product Manager partners cross-functionally to deliver and maintain innovative, high-impact products that meet business objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute 5-year product roadmaps, managing the product lifecycle from development to obsolescence
* Set product priorities for new developments and manage product P&L to optimize margins
* Create comprehensive business cases outlining expected returns
* Define product positioning and ensure designs meet customer use cases
* Owns and accurately maintains product information throughout the lifecycle
* Gather and analyze Voice of Customer insights to inform product features and functionality
* Translate market and customer insights into clear product requirements, features, and technical direction
* Balance growth, cost, and profitability through disciplined product portfolio and lifecycle management
* Own product data integrity and structure, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and alignment with global data standards to enable effective commercialization, analytics, and digital tools
* Support pricing strategy and execution by providing product inputs (e.g., cost, features, value drivers) and partnering with Pricing to enable value-based pricing, margin optimization, and competitive positioning
* Develop and support sales enablement tools (e.g., product documentation, technical collateral, value drivers) to ensure accurate representation of product capabilities and effective customer engagement
* Partner cross-functionally (engineering, operations, commercial) to ensure successful delivery and adoption
* Continuously refine products based on performance, feedback, and evolving customer needs

**KPIs**

* Revenue and profitability by product line
* Market share growth vs. competitors
* ROI on new product development
* Roadmap execution (on-time, in-scope delivery)
* Customer satisfaction and product adoption

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum five years of experience in product management, product development, or a related field.
* Proven leadership and communication skills with success in aligning cross-functional teams to deliver product roadmaps and achieve revenue goals.
* Advanced proficiency with product lifecycle management tools, data analysis platforms, and performance tracking systems.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills rooted in data-driven decision-making and customer-centric product development.
* A relentless pursuit of excellence and a strong desire to build innovative products that deliver profitable growth and competitive differentiation.
* Deep commitment to ownership, continuous learning, and taking proactive steps to improve product outcomes.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, engineering, marketing, or a related field.
* Advanced knowledge of product positioning, pricing strategies, and P&L management.
* Experience in developing business cases, ROI analysis, and product roadmaps.
* Deep understanding of Voice of Customer (VoC) insights, translating into product requirements.
* Familiarity with agile development methodologies and tools.

**Our Commitment to Our People**
Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.
  
  
Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal - to make the world a better place. jobs.description:
**About The Team**
Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.
  
  
Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉
  
  
We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
  
  
But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Product Manager I who is passionate about solving high-impact problems in a fast-paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category management, marketing, operations, finance, etc. to bring a new product to life.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritised problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engineering., business, etc Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (design, engg. business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward-looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.

**What You Will Need**

* Overall experience of 3+ yrs with at least 1+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet space is preferred).
* Exceptional problem-solving skills based on first principles of thinking.
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills to get work done across different functions and drive product development.

CTB Foods & Hospitality Pvt. Ltd. is a growing B2B bakery manufacturer supplying burger buns, breads, pitas, pizza bases and specialty bakery products to restaurants, cafés, QSRs and cloud kitchens.

This is a leadership role requiring someone who can independently assess existing practices, establish effective quality systems, implement improvements and ensure consistent standards throughout our manufacturing operations.

**About Our Team:-**

Our team owns Identity, Access and API Management for Elsevier. We're focused on making access to our products frictionless and secure, with modern access solutions that make customer onboarding easier and sign-in simpler, without compromising security. We work closely with the product managers of Elsevier's products, and with Technology, Design, Data, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, to solve real customer access problems. As a Product Manager II on our team, you will work toward owning the end-to-end value and outcomes of identity and access features, from discovery through to delivery and adoption. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will drive product requirements through specs for your feature area (using genAI and Spec-Driven Development (SDD) as part of your process), execute against the roadmap, and keep your features running well day to day. jobs.title: AI Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
**Imagine yourself...**

* Doing meaningful work that makes an everyday impact on the world around you.
* Owning your ambition and fueling your career growth.
* Collaborating with a vibrant, diverse, global team.

Headquartered in Broomfield, Colorado, TraceGains, a Veralto company, connects people and information so teams can work smarter. We provide networked innovation, quality, and compliance solutions that help consumer brands reduce supply chain risk, accelerate business processes, and take control of their data.

At TraceGains, we believe “we’re in this together.” Innovation and ingenuity start with a diverse workforce and an inclusive workplace, and we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

**Reporting to the Head of AI,** the AI Operations Engineer will deploy, operate, and continuously improve the infrastructure supporting AI applications, agentic systems, and machine learning workloads. This hands-on role combines DevOps, MLOps, and LLMOps to make AI delivery repeatable, secure, observable, reliable, and cost-effective. The role is based in India and contributes to shared DevOps improvements across engineering.

**In this role, a typical day will look like:**

* Build and operate Azure infrastructure, containerized services, networking, storage, model-serving environments, and agentic workflows using infrastructure as code and reusable modules.
* Automate CI/CD pipelines for AI services, models, prompts, and configurations, including testing, evaluation gates, versioning, staged deployment, traceability, and rollback.
* Implement production observability through dashboards, logging, tracing, alerts, service-level objectives, and monitoring of reliability, quality, latency, token usage, and cost.
* Improve operational resilience by troubleshooting failures, managing quotas and rate limits, conducting load and capacity tests, validating backup and recovery procedures, and participating in incident response and root-cause analysis.
* Apply security and governance controls such as identity and access management, secrets handling, least-privilege access, tenant isolation, data-retention controls, sensitive-data protection, and audit logging.
* Provide reproducible development and evaluation environments, maintain operational documentation and runbooks, support retrieval pipelines and agent workflows, and contribute reusable DevOps tooling across engineering.

**The essential requirements of the job include:**

* 3+ years of experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands-on experience operating production services on Microsoft Azure and deploying or supporting at least one production AI or machine learning service.
* Strong foundations in Linux, networking, containers, Git-based workflows, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD, with working proficiency in Python and familiarity with shell scripting.
* Practical experience with Terraform or Bicep, GitHub Actions or Azure Pipelines, and production monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, incident troubleshooting, and cloud cost management.
* Understanding of secure deployment practices, including identity and access management, secrets handling, tenant isolation, and sensitive-data protection, plus the ability to work independently and collaborate across AI, engineering, platform, and security teams.

**It would be a plus if you also possess:**

* Experience operating AI-enabled enterprise SaaS products or agentic applications in production, particularly on Azure.
* Experience with Kubernetes or Azure managed container services, model-serving platforms, LLM observability, evaluation pipelines, model registries, experiment tracking, or model and dataset versioning.
* Experience supporting retrieval systems, vector databases, fine-tuning pipelines, GPU workloads, enterprise data governance, or the food, beverage, and supplements industry.

**What success looks like in the first six months:**

* Deliver repeatable releases with tested rollback for assigned services.
* Establish actionable reliability, quality, and cost dashboards.
* Validate runbooks and recovery procedures.
* Deliver at least one reusable DevOps improvement adopted beyond the AI team.

**Why you’ll want to join us:**

TraceGains is a growing software company providing cloud-based new product development and compliance solutions for food, beverage, and dietary supplement companies. Our network platform digitizes documentation, automates workflows, and helps customers share information across their supply chains.

TraceGains is part of Veralto, a global family of companies united by a shared purpose: Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources™. You will work in a collaborative environment where purpose meets possibility and where your work can have an everyday impact.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

TraceGains provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment based on any characteristic protected by applicable law. Employment is subject to applicable work-authorization and background-screening requirements.

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

**Unsolicited Assistance**

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  

“We Power the Magic!” That’s our motto at Disney Experiences (DX). Our team creates world-class immersive digital experiences for the Company’s premier vacation brands including Disney’s Parks & Resorts worldwide, Disney Cruise Line, Aulani, a Disney Resort & Spa, and Disney Vacation Club.

We are responsible for the end-to-end digital and physical Guest experience for all technology & digital-led initiatives across the Attractions & Entertainment, Food & Beverage, Resorts & Transportation and Merchandise lines of business as well as other initiatives including MyDisneyExperience and Hey, Disney!

As a Senior Software Engineer within Disney Experiences Technology, you will help create immersive digital products that bring Disney’s stories to life across theme parks, resorts, cruise vacations, and consumer experiences worldwide. In this role, you will operate as a skilled, independent worker who solves complex problems, mentors less experienced colleagues, and contributes effective, high-quality solutions that enhance guest and business experiences.

**Responsibilities:**

In this role, you will design, build, test, and maintain software solutions that support end-to-end guest and business journeys across Disney Experiences, from travel and vacation planning to in-park and retail interactions. You will work with minimal guidance, act as a resource for teammates, and apply your problem-solving skills to deliver effective, scalable systems that help Disney provide creative, customer-focused, and innovative experiences around the world. This role matters because it ensures our technology is reliable, performant, and easy to evolve, requiring a proficient engineer who is detail-oriented, collaborative, and able to explain complex concepts clearly.

* Conceive, design, develop, test, and implement software components, enhancements, fixes, and new applications across web and cloud-based platforms.
* Contribute to and sometimes lead the design and implementation of custom applications, integrations, microservices, and APIs that support high-volume, highly scalable systems.
* Work independently to deliver assigned tasks from planning through implementation, adapting to changing business requirements while maintaining code quality and performance.
* Participate in agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, demos, retrospectives) and collaborate with product, design, QA, and other stakeholders to define scalable, maintainable solutions.
* Perform regular code reviews, enforce coding standards, and support unit, behavioral, and integration testing to ensure high-quality, secure, and performant software.
* Monitor applications using tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, or similar solutions, troubleshoot production issues, and proactively improve system reliability and run quality.
* Explain difficult or sensitive technical concepts to non-technical partners and collaborate across teams to align on requirements, architecture, and implementation approaches.
* Offer guidance and informal mentorship to junior engineers by sharing best practices, providing constructive feedback, and modeling effective problem-solving approaches.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Strong proficiency in Java for building production-grade, scalable applications and services.
* Experience developing front-end applications using JavaScript frameworks such as Angular and/or React, and back-end services using Node.js.
* Knowledge of microservices architectures, RESTful web services, and API design for high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems.
* Proficiency in object-oriented programming, design principles, and common design patterns for multi-tier web applications.
* Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging technologies such as Pub/Sub or Kafka.
* Strong knowledge of unit testing, behavioral or component testing, and continuous integration practices and tools.
* Experience using monitoring and logging tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, New Relic, or similar platforms to support production systems.
* Ability to work effectively in agile teams, collaborate with cross-functional partners, and communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions.
* Minimum Required Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Years Of Experience: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including full software development lifecycle responsibilities.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience developing cloud-based or cloud-native solutions using AWS or similar platforms, including managed and serverless technologies such as Docker, ECS, Lambda, or Kubernetes.
* Database design and implementation experience with both relational and NoSQL databases, such as MariaDB, DynamoDB, or MongoDB.
* Experience with QA and software analytics tools, CI/CD pipelines, and automated release management systems.
* Background in hospitality, travel, vacation ownership, licensing, or commerce-related domains.

This position is with Walt Disney Attractions Technology LLC, which is part of a business we call Disney Experiences.

* **2. Sampling Techniques:**
* Familiarity with advanced sampling techniques such as Headspace Samplers, Thermal Desorption Units, Pyrolyzers, and other front-end sample introduction systems
* **3. Analytical Methodology:**
* Proven experience in analytical method development, optimization, and validation using GC, GC-MS, and GC-MS/MS platforms. Ability to design robust methods to address complex analytical challenges and ensure reproducibility
* **4. Application Knowledge by Industry Segment:**
* Understanding of typical application workflows aligned with specific industry requirements (e.g., pharmaceuticals, food & beverages, environmental, petrochemicals, forensic, or clinical research). Should be able to translate customer requirements into analytical solutions
* **5. Regulatory Knowledge:**
* Awareness of global regulatory standards and compliance requirements such as US FDA, EPA, ICH, USP, GLP, and ISO guidelines. Prior experience in working under regulated environments would be highly desirable
* **6. Sample Preparation Techniques:**
* Well-versed with diverse sample preparation methods including extraction (liquid-liquid, solid-phase), digestion, purification, derivatization, and clean-up techniques. Understanding of how these steps impact final analytical results is essential
* **7. Additional Desirable Skills:**
* a. Ability to handle complex data analysis and interpret mass spectral information. b. Familiarity with software platforms used in GC/GC-MS/GC-MS/MS workflows. c. Strong problem-solving aptitude with innovative thinking for method troubleshooting. d. Effective technical communication skills to support customers, teams, and training sessions

Achieves personal booking goals.

**Education and Experience**

* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 3 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

OR

* Works with sales leader to ensure understanding of sales strategy and effective implementation of this strategy for the segment.

* Provides positive and aggressive leadership to ensure maximum revenue potential (e.g., sets example with personal booking goals).

* Assists Revenue Management with completing accurate six period projections.

* Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of department meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
* **About Aptiv**

  Aptiv is a global technology company that develops safer, greener and more connected solutions, which enable the future of mobility. Headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, Aptiv has 160,000 employees and operates 14 technical centers, as well as manufacturing sites and customer support centers, in 44 countries. Visit aptiv.com

    

  Today, our mission is to shape the world with more safer, greener and more connected solutions that's changing the world. We are dedicated to bring the next generation of autonomous vehicles, smart cities and connectivity to life.

    

  **Help shape the future of mobility.**

  Imagine a world with zero vehicle accidents, zero vehicle emissions, and wireless vehicle connectivity all around us. Every day, we move closer to making that world a reality. Aptiv’s passionate team of engineers and developers creates advanced safety systems, high-performance electrification solutions and data connectivity solutions so that automakers can bring advanced capabilities to more people around the globe. This is how we enable sustainable mobility and help to prevent accidents caused by human error.

    
    

  **Software Architect**

  The Software Architect is responsible for defining, governing, and evolving the software architecture of automotive products and platforms. This role leads to architectural decisions from concept through production, ensuring solutions are scalable, reusable, safe, secure, and aligned with customer, business, and technical requirements. The Software Architect provides technical leadership across cross-functional teams and serves as the key authority for software architecture, quality, and engineering best practices.

    
    

  **Responsibilities**

  + Define, document, and maintain software architecture for products and platforms.
  + Analyze customer, system, safety, cybersecurity, and business requirements and translate them into architectural solutions.
  + Define software components, interfaces, design patterns, and non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, reliability, timing, and security).
  + Drive architectural reviews, code reviews, technical assessments, and design decisions.
  + Ensure compliance with software development standards, coding guidelines, and automotive processes.
  + Collaborate with Functional Safety and Cybersecurity teams to develop safety and security concepts.
  + Support software DFMEA, verification activities, and production release readiness.
  + Work directly with customers, suppliers, and stakeholders to understand requirements and resolve technical issues.
  + Support Agile development teams during implementation and ensure adherence to architectural intent.
  + Participate in PI Planning, technical roadmap development, quotation activities, and Proof-of-Concept initiatives.
  + Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across globally distributed teams.
  + Promote Built-In Quality, software reusability, and continuous improvement.
  + Define and evolve common software platforms, architectural frameworks, runtime environments, and reusable technology building blocks enabling scalability across programs
  + Manage architectural risks and technical debts, support the long-term technology strategy
  + Adoption of AI-assisted architecture practices to improve engineering productivity  

  **Requirements (required):**

  + Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  + Extensive experience in software development, embedded systems, and software architecture, including the design and delivery of complex software products and platforms.
  + Proven experience defining and implementing software architecture in complex product development environments.
  + Experience with embedded systems, microcontrollers, multi-threaded software, and RTOS platforms (Linux, QNX, OSEK, or similar).
  + Strong knowledge of software architecture, design patterns, software interfaces, and system integration.
  + Experience with architectural modeling tools (e.g., Enterprise Architect).
  + Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical leadership skills.
  + Knowledge of automotive communication protocols (CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet).
  + Experience in AUTOSAR and/or Service Oriented COM framework: Adaptive AUTOSAR/ROS/ROS2/DDS/SOMEIP
  + Experience in Embedded Software development on ARM Core (A53/A72) and Real time Core based SOC/MCU
  + Familiarity with GPU/NPU/DSP
  + Automotive Knowledge - ADAS / Perception / Parking
  + CICD knowledge and familiarity with Gerrit workflow
  + Experience with requirements management tools such as DOORS or Polarion.
  + Familiarity with, ASPICE, MISRA, and automotive software development processes.
  + Knowledge of Functional Safety (ISO 26262) and automotive cybersecurity principles.
  + Experience with Git, static analysis tools, and software performance profiling.
  + Understanding of open-source software governance and licensing.
  + Experience working within Agile/SAFe environments.
  + Experience working with global, cross-functional development teams.
  + Strong communication / presentation skills and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across organizational levels.
  + Ability to lead technical activities, coordinate development tasks, and provide guidance to team members.  

  **Why join us?**

  **You grow at Aptiv.**

  Aptiv's winning culture is global by design. We bring together diverse perspectives, cultures, and business contexts to solve our customers' toughest challenges. In this environment, every individual can grow, lead, and make an impact, regardless of background, because inclusion fuels how we innovate and win.

  **You make an impact at Aptiv.**

  One of the strengths of humanity is our drive to progress, to improve, to achieve more tomorrow than we did yesterday. People need solutions they can trust when it matters most. At Aptiv, you are building those solutions every day.

  **You have support at Aptiv.**

  We ensure you have the resources and support you need to take care of your family, your physical health, and your mental health with a competitive benefits package.

    

  **Your Benefits at Aptiv:**

Aptiv empowers customers to create solutions people rely on—advancing safety and autonomy in Automotive and Commercial Vehicles, enabling mission-critical performance in Aerospace & Defense, and powering intelligent systems across Energy, Enterprise, and Telecommunications. jobs.title: Technical Lead Manager, Telematics
jobs.description:
**Who we are:**

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

**About the Role**

As a Tech Lead Manager, Telematics, you will lead the technical direction and execution of complex telematics initiatives that connect Motive’s hardware, software, and fleet-management experiences. You will combine deep technical expertise with people leadership to guide architecture, delivery, quality, and engineering effectiveness across the team.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can define a clear technical vision, make sound trade-offs, manage/ develop engineers, and work across teams to deliver reliable products for Motive’s customers.

**What You’ll Do**

* Define and communicate the technical vision, roadmap, and execution plans for telematics initiatives.
* Lead architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and engineering decisions for complex telematics systems.
* Manage, coach, and develop engineers while building a high-performing and accountable team.
* Collaborate cross functionally with internal stakeholders to help define roadmap.
* Drive delivery, launch readiness, define key metrics and operational quality for products and features across the full engineering lifecycle.
* Establish and improve engineering standards, development practices, testing strategies, and release processes.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 8+ years of experience in software, significant Android development or a related engineering domain (preferably AOSP experience).
* 2+ years of experience managing and developing engineering teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong technical depth in mobile engineering, operating systems, distributed systems, cloud platforms, Java, Kotlin and Android development at OS level.
* Experience leading complex projects from technical definition through implementation, validation, and launch.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager – Gummies & Nutraceuticals (R&D)
jobs.description:
Job Description | Mosaic Wellness Pvt. Ltd. | Research & Development
  
  
**Role at a glance**
Mosaic Wellness is hiring an Assistant Manager to own gummy and nutraceutical development, from bench formulation to commercial launch.
  
  
**Position**
Assistant Manager – Gummies & Nutraceuticals
**Function**
Research & Development (New Product Development)
**Location**
Thane West, Mumbai
**Reports to**
Head of R&D
**Experience**
6–10 years in nutraceutical R&D, including hands-on gummy development
**Education**
M.Sc. (Science) or M.Tech in a relevant discipline
**Travel**
Regular visits to CDMO and supplier sites across India
**Employment**
Full-time
  
  
**About Mosaic Wellness**
Mosaic Wellness is a Mumbai-based, digital-first health and wellness company. Its consumer brands, including Man Matters, Be Bodywise and Little Joys, serve men’s, women’s and children’s health and nutrition needs.
  
  
Our R&D team develops science-led nutraceuticals, functional foods and personal care products with manufacturing partners across India. Gummies are a key format across the portfolio.
  
  
**Role purpose**
You will own gummy and nutraceutical products end to end: formulation on the bench, scale-up at CDMOs, and a stable, compliant commercial launch.
  
  
The role solves the hard problems of the gummy format: high active loads, taste masking, sugar reduction, texture and shelf-life stability. You will be R&D’s point person for this category across brands, working closely with Brand, Quality, Regulatory, Procurement and manufacturing partners.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Formulation and product development**

* Develop gummies across gelling systems (gelatin, pectin, carrageenan, agar, starch), including vegan, sugar-free and reduced-sugar variants.
* Formulate with demanding actives: vitamins, minerals, botanicals, probiotics, prebiotic fibres and other high-load ingredients.
* Engineer taste and texture through bitterness masking, flavour and acid profiling, chew optimisation, colour stability, sanding and oil coating.
* Design out gummy failure modes: sweating, stickiness, crystallisation, syneresis, heat deformation, browning and active degradation.
* Extend expertise to other formats as needed: powders and sachets, tablets, capsules, effervescents and chewables.

Mosaic Wellness Pvt. Ltd. | Page of
  
  

* Run bench trials, Design of Experiments (DoE) and sensory evaluations, with complete lab records.

**Process development, scale-up and tech transfer**

* Define critical process parameters: cook temperature and solids (°Brix), deposit pH and temperature, deposit weight, curing conditions and final water activity.
* Lead pilot, scale-up and first commercial batches on starch mogul and starchless depositing lines at CDMO sites.
* Prepare tech-transfer packages: formula, bill of materials, process flow, Master Formula Record inputs and specifications.
* Troubleshoot weight variation, tailing, mould sticking and yield loss to deliver right-first-time commercialisation.

**Stability, quality and analytics**

* Design accelerated and real-time stability studies under ICH-aligned conditions (including Zone IVb, 30 °C/75% RH) to set overages and shelf life.
* Write raw material, packaging and finished-goods specifications; review analytical data with in-house teams and NABL-accredited labs.
* Select packaging for moisture and oxygen protection, backed by water-activity and moisture-sorption data.
* Lead root-cause analysis and CAPA for deviations, out-of-specification results and consumer complaints.

**Regulatory and documentation**

* Keep formulations and labels compliant with FSSAI’s Health Supplements and Nutraceuticals Regulations (2022), Labelling and Display Regulations (2020) and AYUSH norms where relevant.
* Check ingredient permissibility, RDA-based limits and label claims; prepare technical dossiers, including for Non-Specified Food approvals.
* Support export-market requirements (e.g., GCC, US 21 CFR) with Regulatory Affairs.

**Ingredients, partners and cost**

* Scout and qualify new ingredients, technologies and suppliers, and develop alternate sources for supply resilience.
* Assess CDMO capability and build strong technical partnerships with manufacturing and ingredient partners.
* Hit COGS targets through formulation and process value engineering, without compromising efficacy or sensory quality.

**Collaboration and team**

* Translate brand and consumer briefs into technical briefs, and deliver launches on the NPD calendar with cross-functional teams.
* Guide and mentor junior scientists, and share learnings across R&D.
* Track global gummy and delivery-format trends, and contribute to patents and scientific publications.

**What We’re Looking For**
**Education**
**One Of The Following**

* M.Sc. in Food Science and Technology, Food and Nutrition, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biotechnology or Pharmaceutical Sciences
* M.Tech in Food Technology, Food Engineering, Chemical Engineering or Pharmaceutical Technology

Mosaic Wellness Pvt. Ltd. | Page of
  
  
**Experience**

* 6–10 years in R&D or NPD for nutraceuticals, health supplements or functional foods, at a consumer brand, nutraceutical company or CDMO.
* At least 3 years of hands-on gummy development, with products taken from concept to commercial launch.
* Scale-up experience on mogul or starchless depositing lines, in-house or at a CDMO.
* A track record of stability-led formulation, setting overages and shelf life for vitamins, botanicals or probiotics.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong grasp of hydrocolloid and sugar/polyol science: gelation, pH and calcium sensitivity, glass transition, crystallisation and water activity.
* Confident with analytical data: assay and HPLC results, moisture and water activity, texture analysis and microbiology.
* Working knowledge of FSSAI nutraceutical and labelling regulations, GMP and HACCP.
* Structured experimentation (DoE), clear technical documentation and crisp reporting.
* Able to run several projects, CDMOs and stakeholders in parallel.

**Good to have**

* Experience with tablets, capsules, softgels, powders or effervescents alongside gummies.
* Probiotic, high-fibre, high-load or centre-filled gummy development.
* Work with microencapsulated actives or other novel delivery formats.
* Exposure to export regulations: US 21 CFR 111, GCC (GSO) or EU.
* Experience in a D2C or fast-growing consumer health company.
* Patents or peer-reviewed publications.
* Statistical tools such as Minitab, JMP or Design-Expert.

**What Success Looks Like In The First 12 Months**
Within a year, gummies are a dependable, scalable platform for Mosaic’s brands.
  
  

* Gummy and nutraceutical launches delivered on the NPD calendar, scaled up right first time at CDMOs.
* Every launched SKU meets label claim through shelf life, backed by robust stability data.
* Measurable COGS savings from value engineering on existing products.
* A stronger gummy platform: documented process windows, qualified alternate suppliers and fewer quality complaints.

**Why join**
You get real ownership, scientific depth and room to grow.
  
  

* Own a key format end to end, with direct influence on what reaches consumers.
* Work in a lean, decentralised R&D team where scientists own their projects and decisions sit close to the bench.
* Grow beyond gummies into nutraceuticals, functional foods and novel delivery technologies.
* Build your scientific profile through patents and publications, alongside leaders with deep global CPG experience.

jobs.title: Coffee Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Coffee Program Manager**

**About the Role:**

We're looking for a Coffee Program Manager who can do two things equally well: dream up drinks people want to talk about, and build the systems that let multiple outlets execute them exactly the same way, every time. This role does not include roasting or green coffee sourcing — that sits with our Head Roaster and Quality Team. Your world is the bar: recipes, technique, equipment, training, and the guest-facing experience across every location. This is a role for someone who gets genuinely excited about a new milk texture or extraction tweak, but who also can't stand watching a great drink get executed inconsistently three miles away.

**What You'll Own:**

**Menu & Drink Development**

● Design and test new beverages (espresso-based, batch, seasonal, non-coffee) from concept to menu-ready

● Stay ahead of trends and translate them into drinks that fit our brand and margins

● Partner with the Head Roaster and Quality Team to build drinks around each roast's strengths

● Run tastings and calibration sessions to pressure-test new recipes before rollout

**Operations & Consistency**

●
Build and maintain SOPs and recipe specs (dial-in parameters, pour ratios, milk temps, presentation) so every outlet produces the same cup

● Design and run training programs for baristas and shift leads, including onboarding and skill certification ● Set up quality-control checks (cupping, spot audits, secret-shopper visits) across all outlets

● Manage equipment standards and maintenance schedules to eliminate variance from bad kit

● Own recipe costing and pour costs; balance creativity against margin targets

**Cross-Outlet Execution**

● Visit outlets regularly to audit execution against spec, not just review reports

● Create feedback loops so issues at one location get fixed everywhere, not just patched locally

● Coordinate menu rollouts and timing across all locations so launches land together

● Assist with B2B Accounts and Quality Programs where required

● Conduct Coffee Workshops when required (Customer Facing)

**What You Bring**

● 3+ years managing a multi-location beverage or coffee program, or equivalent experience running a high-volume single site with clear ambition to scale

● A track record of drinks you've created that actually shipped and sold

● Deep hands-on espresso/bar craft — a genuinely trained palate that can dial in, identify defects, and talk origin characteristics

● Systems thinking: your default is “how do I make this repeatable,” not just “how do I make this good once”

● Comfortable building training materials, SOPs, and checklists from scratch

● Basic P&L literacy — pour cost, recipe costing, labor impact of menu decisions

● Willingness to travel regularly between outlets

**Nice to Have**

● Experience working alongside a dedicated roasting/quality team and large team of Baristas

● Competition or judging experience (barista competitions, cupping certifications)

● Experience launching a new outlet's bar program from zero

● Experience with a range of equipments such as semi-automatic and automatic

jobs.description:
How to Apply

* Visit our careers page: counton.ai/careers/chief-of-staff-operations and apply for faster response

The role

R&D, service, production and sales at CountAI all move fast — and the most important work stalls between them. You run the company's daily execution rhythm: every morning you know what matters most, who owns it and what is blocking it. You clear blocks before they cost us a customer date, and you give top management one honest picture of where things stand and who is delivering. You work directly with the CEO and leadership to get the top-priority work done.

What you will do

* Run the morning meeting every day in 20 minutes or less: understand how each team's tasks flow and set their order of importance, so everyone works on what matters most.
* Keep one company priority list with owners, dates and dependencies. When priorities clash between teams, settle it — or take it to leadership the same day.
* Make sure no task is blocked anywhere in operations — R&D, service, production, purchase or sales. Find the block, name the owner, follow up until it is cleared.
* Track delivery by person — who commits, who delivers on time, and where people need help — and share it fairly with their managers as a monthly view.
* Give management a weekly overview: what moved, what slipped and why, the risks coming up, and the decisions needed.
* Turn leadership decisions into tracked actions, and close every loop.
* Build the tracking system itself — sheets, Jira or ClickUp, and AI tools — so it runs without chasing by email.

Who we are looking for

* 5–10 years in operations, production planning, a PMO or project management at an engineering, manufacturing or technology company.
* You have run daily or weekly review meetings with team leads — and people respected the follow-up.
* You understand both how a factory runs and how R&D works; you can tell an engineering delay from a purchase delay.
* Firm and fair: you can tell a senior engineer their task is late and still have their trust tomorrow.
* Organised and data-minded: your tracker is the one source everyone trusts. Comfortable with spreadsheets, project tools and AI assistants.
* Fluent in English and Tamil.
* An MBA, PMP or Scrum certification is a plus; your track record matters more.

As the **world’s largest** manufacturer of motorcycles and scooters for the last **25 years**, Hero is where you will get to work with the brightest innovators, passionate about being the best in what they do. Hero MotoCorp, headquartered in New Delhi, India, is the world's largest manufacturer of motorcycles and scooters for 25 consecutive years with ~$5 billion revenue. The Company operates eight manufacturing facilities - six in India and one each in Colombia and Bangladesh- along with two Research and Development centres: Centre for Innovation and Technology (CIT) in India and Tech Centre Germany (TCG).
  
Hero MotoCorp is driving the transition to electric mobility through VIDA, powered by Hero.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager (Field Technical Support – CNG)
jobs.description:
**Company:** CEV Engineering  
**Department:** Service & Technical Support  
**Designation:** Assistant Manager  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years (Automotive Industry Preferred)  
**Qualification:** B.Tech / Diploma in Automobile or Mechanical Engineering  
**Job Location:** Delhi NCR / Field Operations

**1. Job Purpose**

To manage CNG vehicle field issues, provide technical support to dealers, coordinate with OEM and plant quality teams, and ensure timely resolution of customer and dealer complaints. The role will focus on improving product quality, reducing warranty claims, strengthening dealer technical capabilities, and improving service performance.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Field Issue Management**

* Handle and investigate CNG vehicle technical complaints reported by dealers and customers.
* Conduct vehicle inspections and field visits to identify root causes of technical issues.
* Analyse recurring failures and prepare detailed technical investigation reports.
* Coordinate with OEM, Plant Quality, R&D, and Production teams for corrective actions.
* Monitor complaint trends and ensure timely closure of field issues.
* Escalate critical and repetitive issues to senior management.

**B. Dealer Technical Support**

* Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support to dealer service teams.
* Plan and conduct dealer visits for technical issue resolution.
* Ensure proper CNG system inspection and repair procedures are followed.
* Support dealers in reducing unnecessary part replacement.
* Monitor dealer technical performance and identify training requirements.

**C. Warranty Management**

* Monitor CNG parts warranty claims and replacement activities.
* Analyse warranty failures and identify high-failure components.
* Coordinate with dealers for defective part return and technical investigation.
* Monitor warranty claim numbers and warranty cost.
* Work towards reducing repeat failures and unnecessary warranty claims.

**D. Technical Training & Development**

* Organise technical training for dealer technicians and service advisors.
* Develop training materials, technical manuals, and troubleshooting guides.
* Conduct practical training on CNG components and diagnostic tools.
* Evaluate dealer technicians' technical knowledge and capabilities.

**E. Reporting & Documentation**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly field issue reports.
* Maintain a technical complaint database and track issue closure.
* Prepare 8D reports, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and Corrective Action Reports.
* Monitor KPIs related to field complaints, warranty claims, and dealer performance.
* Present technical performance and improvement plans to management.

**F. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with OEM Quality, Service, Plant Quality, R&D, and Production teams.
* Follow up on corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Support new vehicle launches and CNG system validation activities.
* Coordinate with internal teams for spare parts availability and technical support.

**3. Required Technical Skills**

* Good knowledge of CNG vehicle systems and components.
* Knowledge of CNG regulators, injectors, pressure sensors, cylinders, HP tubes, and fittings.
* Understanding of CNG diagnostics and scanning tools.
* Knowledge of vehicle troubleshooting and failure analysis.
* Understanding of warranty processes and quality tools (5 Why, Fishbone, 8D).
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and technical reporting.

**4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Reduction in repeat field complaints.
* Reduction in warranty claims and warranty costs.
* Timely closure of field issues.
* Dealer technical support response time.
* Number of dealer technical training sessions conducted.
* Improvement in first-time-right repair performance.
* Reduction in unnecessary part replacement.
* Timely submission of RCA and corrective action reports.

**5. Competencies Required**

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Team management and leadership abilities.
* Effective communication and coordination.
* Decision-making and escalation management.
* Customer and dealer handling skills.
* Willingness to travel for field inspections and dealer support.

**6. Expected Deliverables**

* Timely resolution of CNG field issues.
* Improved dealer technical capabilities.
* Reduced warranty cost and repeat complaints.
* Effective coordination with OEM and plant teams.
* Improved CNG service quality and customer satisfaction.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

**Responsibilities**:

**Regulatory Strategy and Submissions**: Develop and implement regulatory strategies for new and existing products. This includes preparing, submitting, and managing product registration dossiers, notifications, and applications to various regulatory bodies. The manager must stay informed on the latest regulations to advise on product formulations, claims, and labelling to ensure market entry and continued compliance.

**Documentation and Compliance**: A core duty is maintaining meticulous records. The manager oversees the creation and maintenance of technical files, safety dossiers, and other documentation required for product registrations. They are responsible for ensuring ongoing compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), labelling requirements, and advertising standards.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**: The regulatory manager works closely with various departments, including Research & Development (R&D), Quality Assurance, Marketing, and Legal. They provide regulatory guidance throughout the product lifecycle, from initial concept and formulation to marketing and post-market surveillance. For example, they advise the marketing team on permissible health claims and the R&D team on ingredient compliance.

**Liaison with Regulatory Agencies**: They serve as the main point of contact for regulatory authorities. This includes responding to inquiries, addressing deficiencies, and negotiating with agencies to expedite product approvals. They also represent the company at industry forums and consultations.

**Audits and Inspections**: The manager prepares for and manages internal and external audits by regulatory bodies or third-party certifiers. They ensure all facilities, processes, and documentation are inspection-ready at all times.

**Regulatory Intelligence and Risk Management**: They proactively monitor the global regulatory landscape, including new and proposed legislation, guidelines, and industry trends. They then assess the potential impact of these changes on the company's product portfolio and develop risk mitigation strategies.

Preparation and filing of new drug applications (NDA), for submission to regulatory authorities.

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Production Manager- Sanitary Pads & Hygiene Products

**Location:** Pune

**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Department:** Production/ Operations

**Reports To:** Managing Director

**CTC:** 10-15 LPA

**Direct reports**: Production, Maintenance & Engineering, Quality Assurance / Quality Control, Planning & Stores, EHS, Plant HR/Admin (via functional heads)

**Company Description:**

Xolopak India Ltd is a pioneering company in manufacturing sustainable consumable products for HORECA, Bakery and Home/Personal care industry in India. We operate in B2B and institutional business within this segment and have a pan India presence. Our products include single use wooden cutlery, ice-cream sticks and spoons, cake bases, Silver Pouches, luxury napkins etc. Our prestigious customers include some of the largest brands in the food and ice-cream industry.

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a seasoned production Manager to lead end-to-end plant operations for our sanitary napkin and personal hygiene product lines. The role carries full ownership of production, quality, cost, safety, compliance and people, and is accountable for delivering output at the required quality, yield and cost, with a strong focus on high-speed sanitary pad conversion lines.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Production & Operations Management**

* Lead daily plant operations across sanitary pad lines (including ultra-thin, XL and overnight variants) and allied hygiene products such as baby diapers, adult incontinence products, panty liners and wipes, where applicable.

* Ensure achievement of production plans, OEE, line efficiency, throughput and on-time delivery targets.

* Drive reduction of material wastage, rejections, downtime and changeover time across converting, packaging and secondary packing lines.

* Work with Planning, Sales and Supply Chain on production scheduling, capacity planning and demand fulfilment.

**2. Quality & Regulatory Compliance**

* Maintain product quality in line with BIS standards (IS 5405 for sanitary napkins), and applicable FDA/medical-device-type and customer specifications.

* Ensure GMP, hygiene-zone discipline, clean-room and contamination-control practices suitable for products in contact with the body.

* Lead implementation and maintenance of ISO 9001, ISO 13485 (where applicable), ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certifications, and prepare the plant for customer, regulatory and third-party audits.

* Oversee root cause analysis, CAPA, complaint investigation and change control.

**3. Technical & Process Leadership**

* Provide deep technical oversight on raw materials (fluff pulp, SAP, nonwovens, release paper, films, adhesives, hot melts) and their impact on product performance.

* Lead process optimisation, new product trials and scale-up in coordination with R&D and Quality.

* Evaluate, select and commission new machinery; oversee installation, validation and stabilisation of new lines.

* Drive automation, digitisation (MES, SCADA, vision inspection) and modernisation of lines.

**4. Maintenance & Engineering**

* Ensure high equipment uptime through preventive and predictive maintenance, spare-parts planning and TPM practices.

* Oversee utilities including compressed air, HVAC, dust extraction, steam and power, with a focus on energy efficiency.

* Manage capex projects for capacity expansion, debottlenecking and replacement.

**5. Cost, Budgeting & Financial Management**

* Own the manufacturing budget, conversion cost, material yield and cost-per unit targets.

* Drive continuous improvement through Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen and 5S to improve productivity and reduce cost.

* Track and report plant KPIs and MIS to senior management on a regular basis.

**6. Environment, Health & Safety**

* Create and sustain a zero-harm safety culture; ensure statutory compliance under the Factories Act and related labour, pollution-control and fire-safety laws.

* Oversee waste management, effluent and emissions compliance, and sustainability initiatives (including waste reduction and recyclability).

* Build, mentor and retain a high-performing team of engineers, supervisors and operators.

### **1. Job Purpose**

To support New Product Development activities in the confectionery category through hands-on laboratory work, prototype preparation, sample development, product evaluation and execution of R&D trials. The position will be primarily based in the NPD laboratory and responsible for ensuring timely preparation of quality prototypes, lab report preparation and samples as per project requirements.

* Support the development of new product concepts, flavors, textures, shapes and variants.

**D. Documentation & Data Management**

**E. Raw Material & Inventory Management**

* Maintain laboratory raw material inventory and ensure availability of ingredients required for development activities.
* Monitor raw material consumption, expiry dates and storage conditions.

**F. Quality, Safety & Hygiene**

* Follow food safety, personal hygiene and laboratory safety practices.
* Ensure cleanliness and housekeeping of the NPD laboratory.
* Identify and report any deviations in raw material quality or laboratory processing.
* Follow established SOPs and maintain good laboratory practices.

**G. Cross-functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with NPD team members for timely execution of development projects.
* Support Marketing, Quality, Production and other stakeholders in sample preparation and product evaluation.
* Incorporate feedback from sensory evaluations and internal product reviews into subsequent prototypes.

* Hands-on experience in food product development or confectionery laboratory operations.

* Practical knowledge of weighing, mixing, heating, forming, depositing and sample preparation.
* Good observation, analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Basic computer knowledge (MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint).

* Ability to manage multiple sample development requirements and timelines.

This is a hands-on, laboratory-oriented position requiring regular involvement in prototype preparation, product development experiments, sample handling and laboratory operations. **Position:** Assistant Manager – Quality Assurance  
**Industry:** Food / FMCG / Food Manufacturing  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced and technically strong Assistant Manager – Quality Assurance to oversee end-to-end quality assurance and food safety operations across third-party manufacturing facilities and 3PL vendors.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring product quality, food safety compliance, vendor quality governance, process monitoring, and regulatory adherence. The role requires hands-on experience in managing third-party manufacturers or co-packers, conducting quality audits, implementing corrective and preventive actions, and maintaining food safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Vendor Quality Management & Audits**

* Conduct periodic quality and food safety audits at third-party manufacturing and co-packer facilities.
* Ensure vendor compliance with FSSAI, ISO 22000, FSSC 22000, HACCP, and GMP standards.
* Monitor vendor quality performance and ensure adherence to established quality standards.

**2. In-Process & Finished Product Quality**

* Monitor raw material, packaging material, and finished goods inspection processes at vendor locations.
* Review and approve batch release documentation, Certificates of Analysis (COAs), and laboratory reports before dispatch.
* Ensure temperature compliance during product receiving, storage, and dispatch.

**3. CAPA & Root Cause Analysis**

* Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) for customer complaints, non-conformances, and audit observations.
* Manage product hold and release processes, scrap/rework activities, and mock recall exercises.
* Ensure timely closure of quality-related issues.

**4. Process & Hygiene Monitoring**

* Monitor Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Hygiene Practices (GHP), pest control, and sanitation programs.
* Oversee Cleaning-in-Place (CIP) validation and process control checks.
* Ensure food safety and hygiene standards are consistently maintained at third-party facilities.

**5. Cross-Functional & Vendor Coordination**

* Coordinate with internal R&D, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations teams, along with external vendor quality teams.
* Train vendor personnel on quality standards, food safety practices, and testing protocols.
* Drive continuous improvement in vendor quality performance.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Microbiology, Dairy Technology, or Biotechnology.
* 6–8+ years of experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Control within the Food, FMCG, or Contract Manufacturing industry.
* Hands-on experience in managing third-party manufacturing units, vendors, or co-packers is essential.
* Strong knowledge of FSSAI regulations, HACCP, GMP, and Food Safety Management Systems (FSMS).
* Working knowledge of FSSC 22000 and ISO 22000 standards.
* Experience in quality audits, CAPA, Root Cause Analysis, FMEA, and statistical quality tools.
* Strong vendor management, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good team management and interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to travel frequently to third-party manufacturing facilities.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone with strong expertise in food safety, vendor quality management, and third-party manufacturing operations, who can independently drive quality standards and ensure regulatory compliance across multiple vendor facilities.

**Interested candidates are requested to share their updated resumes for consideration.**

jobs.description:
**Job Description:** Pharmaceutical Formulation Consultant (Tablets & Capsules, NPD)

**Engagement type:** Consultant, project-based

**Work location:** Chennai office (on-site)

**Domain:** Pharmaceutical drug formulation and new product development (oral solid dosage)

**Duration:** Project-based, to be defined at onboarding (extendable)

**1. Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Pharmaceutical Formulation Consultant to develop new tablet and capsule products. The consultant will work from our Chennai office for the project duration. The role covers hands-on formulation preparation along with market research that supports product selection and positioning.

**2. Eligibility**

* **Freshers are not eligible to apply.**
* **Minimum 3+ years of hands-on, practical experience in formulation** (lab-level preparation and trials for tablets and/or capsules).
* Candidates with only theoretical or academic exposure, or with experience limited to QC, QA, or regulatory work, will not be considered.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Formulation Development (Tablets & Capsules)**

* Design and develop oral solid dosage formulations (immediate-release, and modified or sustained-release where applicable) for new products.
* Conduct pre-formulation studies: API characterisation, solubility, compatibility, and excipient selection.
* Personally prepare lab-scale formulation trials and optimise them using QbD / DoE principles.
* Select the manufacturing process (direct compression, wet or dry granulation, capsule filling) and define critical process parameters.
* Evaluate and troubleshoot trial batches: hardness, friability, disintegration, dissolution, assay, and content uniformity.
* Run stability studies as per ICH guidelines and interpret the results.
* Prepare formulation documents: Master Formula, development reports, and technical data packages.
* Support scale-up and tech transfer to the manufacturing site.

**B. Market Research**

* Carry out market and competitor analysis for target molecules and dosage forms (market size, demand trends, key players, pricing).
* Identify new product opportunities, including generics, 505(b)(2), nutraceutical-pharma crossover, and niche or unmet-need segments.
* Review the patent landscape, exclusivity status, and reference listed drug (RLD) details.
* Assess the regulatory pathway and market-entry feasibility (India CDSCO and, where relevant, regulated markets).
* Prepare product feasibility reports and a recommended product pipeline with a go / no-go view.

**C. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate lab records and development documentation.
* Share regular progress updates and present findings to management.
* Deliver a final project report with formulation, data, and recommendations.

**4. Required Qualifications**

* M.Pharm (Pharmaceutics / Industrial Pharmacy) or Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Sciences. B.Pharm with strong practical experience may be considered.
* **3+ years of practical formulation experience** in oral solid dosage forms (tablets and capsules).
* Demonstrated involvement in product development trials, from pre-formulation through optimisation.

**5. Required Skills**

* Strong working knowledge of excipients, granulation, compression, coating, and capsule-filling technologies.
* Hands-on use of formulation equipment (blenders, granulators, tablet press, capsule filling machine, coating pan).
* Knowledge of ICH, QbD, and cGMP, plus regulatory requirements for product filing.
* Familiarity with analytical methods: dissolution, HPLC, and related quality tests.
* Ability to conduct market research using IQVIA, patent databases, regulatory databases, and similar sources.
* Strong analytical, report-writing, and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and deliver to timelines.

**6. Preferred**

* Experience with modified-release or complex generics.
* Exposure to regulated-market filings (US FDA, EMA, WHO-GMP).
* Prior consulting experience.

**7. Deliverables**

* Pre-formulation and feasibility reports
* Optimised tablet and capsule formulations with trial batch data
* Stability data summary
* Market research and product opportunity report
* Final technical and project report

**8. Terms**

* **Reporting to:** Project Head

Language:

Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. jobs.description:
VENUS MEDICINE RESEARCH CENTRE (VMRC)

Position: Head – Animal Pharmacology & Toxicology

**Department:**
Preclinical Sciences

**Reports To:**
Chief Scientific Officer

**Location:**
On-site, Full-time

Role Overview

VMRC is advancing a diversified pipeline spanning novel anti-infectives, BL+BLI combinations, and differentiated herbal therapeutics. The Head – Animal Pharmacology & Toxicology will lead all in vivo pharmacology, ADME, toxicology, translational PK–PD, and pharmacometrics activities across the portfolio.

This is a senior scientific leadership role requiring deep expertise in anti-infective development, renal pharmacology, nephrotoxicity assessment, PK–PD modelling, and IND-enabling toxicology, combined with strong regulatory and team leadership capability.

Key Programmes

Renal Guard Programme (Phase 1)

A reformulated polymyxin programme focused on reducing nephrotoxicity while maintaining antimicrobial efficacy.

Key areas:

* Renal injury biomarkers: KIM-1, NGAL, Cystatin C, NAG, Osteopontin
* Renal pharmacology and drug disposition
* Histopathology integration
* Complex PK interpretation in limited-literature settings

Meropenem + MET-X Programme (Late Preclinical)

A BL+BLI combination targeting carbapenem-resistant Gram-negative infections.

Key areas:

* IND-enabling ADME and toxicology
* Translational PK–PD
* Monte Carlo simulation & PTA
* Dose optimisation using:
* fT>MIC
* fAUC/MIC
* Cmax/MIC
* Clinical dose projection and resistance suppression strategy

Qualifications & Experience

* Ph.D. in Pharmacology, Toxicology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Translational Medicine, or related discipline
* 10+ years in preclinical in vivo drug development
* 5+ years leading multidisciplinary preclinical teams
* Experience advancing assets through IND/CTA-enabling development
* Strong expertise in:
* Anti-infectives
* Toxicology
* Renal pharmacology
* PK–PD/pharmacometrics
* GLP laboratory and regulatory submission experience preferred
* Strong publication and scientific presentation record

Key Responsibilities

Scientific Leadership

* Define and execute portfolio-wide in vivo strategy
* Lead pharmacology, toxicology, ADME, and PK–PD functions
* Serve as Study Director/PI for internal and outsourced studies
* Lead team development, budgeting, infrastructure, and resource planning
* Interface with CMC, microbiology, clinical, regulatory, and bioanalytical teams

In Vivo Pharmacology & Infection Models

* Lead rodent and non-rodent infection models:
* Thigh
* Lung
* Sepsis
* Resistance amplification
* Dose-fractionation studies
* Evaluate exposure–response, bacterial burden, survival, and resistance suppression
* Support herbal and metabolic programme evaluation

Renal Pharmacology & Toxicology

* Lead nephrotoxicity strategy for Renal Guard
* Integrate biomarkers, PK, and histopathology
* Interpret renal injury pathways and kidney drug disposition

ADME & Translational PK–PD

* Oversee PK, tissue distribution, ELF/renal penetration, and permeability studies
* Lead NCA, compartmental and population PK analyses
* Conduct PTA and Monte Carlo simulations
* Support dose projection and breakpoint justification

Required tools:

* Phoenix WinNonlin
* NONMEM
* R or equivalent platforms

Toxicology & Safety

* Oversee acute/repeat-dose toxicity, safety pharmacology, TK, and local tolerance studies
* Interpret NOAEL, MTD, therapeutic index, and safety margins
* Ensure alignment with ICH and IND/CTA requirements

Regulatory & GLP

* Lead nonclinical regulatory submissions:
* CTD Modules 2.4, 2.6, 4
* FDA, EMA, CDSCO submissions
* Drive GLP compliance, SOP quality, QA readiness, and facility accreditation
* Support publications, scientific presentations, and regulatory interactions

Regulatory Knowledge (Non-Negotiable)

Strong working knowledge of:

* OECD GLP Principles
* ICH M3(R2), S-series, E6(R2)
* IAEC/CPCSEA guidelines
* IBSC requirements
* ARRIVE & 3Rs principles
* IND/CTA/NDA nonclinical documentation

Ideal Candidate

* Proven anti-infective or antimicrobial development experience
* Exposure to BL+BLI or combination products
* Expertise in nephrotoxicity and renal biomarker science
* Strong translational and regulatory mindset
* Demonstrated ability to build high-performing preclinical teams and infrastructure

We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. The Certification Executive – Organic Compliance will be responsible for managing end-to-end organic certification activities across the manufacturing and processing facility. * B.Sc. Agriculture / M.Sc. Agriculture
* B.Tech Food Technology / M.Sc. Food Science
* Biotechnology / Microbiology
* Quality Assurance or equivalent qualification
* Additional certification in Organic Standards, HACCP, ISO 22000, Food Safety, or Internal Auditor will be an added advantage.

* 4–5 years of relevant experience in organic food processing, certification, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience in certified organic food manufacturing or processing units is mandatory.
* Experience in export-oriented food manufacturing will be preferred.

* Ensure compliance with NPOP, USDA NOP, EU Organic Regulations, and customer-specific organic requirements.

* Ensure packaging materials comply with certification requirements.
