jobs.title: Branch Accountant | Al-Futtaim Automotive| Dubai
jobs.description:
About Al-Futtaim

  

Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

  

**Overview of the role**

  

We are currently hiring a detail-oriented **Branch Accountant** to support the day-to-day finance operations of a busy automotive branch in the UAE.

  

In this role, you will help ensure that financial transactions are accurate, properly documented, reconciled and processed on time. You will provide operational finance support across sales, aftersales, parts and administration, covering customer collections, vendor payments, banking, petty cash, vehicle deal documentation and month-end closing activities.

  

**What you will do**

  

* Review daily branch transactions, including invoices, receipts, customer collections, vendor payments, credit notes and journal entries.
* Check vehicle deal documentation, pricing requests and discount approvals for accuracy and completeness.
* Monitor cash collections, card receipts, bank deposits, petty cash and other banking activities.
* Prepare reconciliations for customer accounts, vendor balances, deposits, advances, clearing accounts and petty cash.
* Investigate outstanding balances, transaction errors and reconciling items, escalating unresolved issues when required.
* Support month-end closing activities, including accruals, provisions, reclassifications, journals and expense reviews.
* Track operating expenses, purchase orders, supplier invoices and cost-centre postings.
* Identify missing approvals, documentation gaps, unusual financial movements and control exceptions.
* Maintain accurate schedules, trackers and supporting documentation for reporting and audit purposes.
* Ensure branch finance activities comply with applicable financial policies, approval requirements and internal controls.
* Coordinate with branch operations, shared services, treasury, credit control and other finance stakeholders.

**Required skills to be successful**

  

* Good understanding of accounting principles and day-to-day financial transactions.
* Strong reconciliation skills and numerical accuracy.
* Knowledge of receivables, payables, banking, petty cash, accruals and financial controls.
* Good Microsoft Excel skills with the ability to maintain accurate trackers and schedules.
* Working knowledge of SAP or a similar ERP system.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation discipline.
* Ability to identify transaction errors, missing approvals and outstanding reconciling items.
* Good communication and follow-up skills.
* Ability to manage daily priorities and meet month-end deadlines.
* A reliable, accountable and process-focused approach to work.

**About the team**

  

You will join a collaborative automotive finance team supporting a high-volume branch environment. You will work closely with the Finance Manager, branch management, sales, service and parts teams, as well as shared services, treasury and credit control.

  

The team plays an important role in maintaining strong financial discipline while providing responsive support to daily branch operations.

  

**What equips you for the role**

  

* A degree or diploma in Accounting, Finance, Commerce or a related discipline.
* **2–4 years of relevant experience** in accounting, branch finance, retail finance, dealership finance or operational finance support.
* Experience preparing reconciliations and supporting month-end closing activities.
* Experience reviewing financial documentation and following up on outstanding items.
* Exposure to automotive, retail, trading or another high-volume transactional environment is preferred.
* Working knowledge of SAP or another ERP system is an advantage.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure during month-end and peak transaction periods.

Al-Futtaim Automotive is one of the region's leading mobility businesses, operating across eight countries in the Middle East, Asia and North Africa.

  

With a portfolio of more than 25 world-leading brands, we deliver one of the region's most comprehensive mobility ecosystems.

  

Our capabilities span passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles and industrial equipment, backed by integrated logistics, leasing, aftersales and financial services that deliver a seamless customer experience across every stage of the mobility journey.

  

Our vision is to become a world-class mobility player, creating better experiences for our customers through innovation, digital transformation and a relentless focus on customer experience. We work alongside some of the world's most trusted automotive brands to shape the future of mobility, delivering solutions that meet the evolving needs of individuals, businesses and communities.

  

Behind everything we do is a team of more than 9,000 colleagues united by ambition, collaboration and a shared commitment to progress. Together, we're shaping the future of mobility, embracing new technologies and creating better experiences for our customers. At Al-Futtaim Automotive, you'll be empowered to turn ambition into action and help move our customers, our business and your career forward.

  

For further information, and to apply, please visit our website via the “Apply” button below.

jobs.title: Specialist Accounting (8 months Contract)
jobs.description:
**Purpose & Overall Relevance for the Organization:**

  

To maintain accurate, complete and timely accounting records for the UAE market through day-to-day accounting, retail sales and cash reconciliation, fixed asset accounting, prepayment accounting and landlord agreed-upon procedures reporting.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

  
* **Day-to-day accounting:** Perform routine accounting, journal preparation, account reconciliation, supporting-document review and month-end close activities for assigned areas.
  
* **Retail sales and cash reconciliation:** Reconcile daily retail sales recorded in retail systems and SAP against cash, card and other tender receipts; identify and follow up variances with stores, banks, payment service providers and relevant internal teams.
  
* **Retail exceptions and ageing:** Maintain visibility of unreconciled retail items, chargebacks, short/over banking and delayed settlements; perform root-cause analysis and drive closure within agreed timelines.
  
* **Fixed asset accounting:** Manage the end-to-end fixed asset process, including review of capital expenditure support, creation and maintenance of fixed asset cards, additions, transfers, capitalization, depreciation checks, disposals and retirements.
  
* **Fixed asset reconciliation and counts:** Reconcile the fixed asset register to the general ledger, investigate differences, coordinate periodic physical asset counts and maintain evidence of approved adjustments.
  
* **Prepayments:** Record and maintain prepayment schedules and ensure postings, release periods and monthly amortization agree to signed lease agreements, invoices and relevant supporting documents.
  
* **Lease-related support:** Work with Real Estate and business owners to obtain complete lease and contractual documentation and resolve discrepancies affecting accounting or landlord reporting.
  
* **KPMG agreed-upon procedures reporting:** Coordinate the AUP process with KPMG, including preparation of schedules, reconciliation of reported sales, collection of supporting evidence, response to queries and finalization of landlord reports.
  
* **Landlord submissions:** Ensure AUP reports and related landlord submissions are complete, accurate, appropriately reviewed and shared within contractual deadlines.
  
* **Month-end and audit support:** Prepare balance-sheet reconciliations, schedules and audit evidence; support internal and external audit requests and timely closure of observations.
  
* **Controls and compliance:** Follow adidas Group Finance policies, IFRS, UAE statutory requirements and internal controls. Escalate material, aged or recurring reconciliation differences promptly.
  
* **Process improvement:** Support simplification, standardization and automation of retail, fixed asset and prepayment accounting processes.
  

**Controlling:**

  
  

  
* Measure progress against own KPIs.
  
* Monitor all allocated reports and reconciliation ageing.
  
* Ensure adherence to Group accounting policies, procedures and internal controls.
  

**KPI's:**

  
  

  
* Daily retail sales and tender reconciliation accuracy and completion.
  
* Timely clearance of cash and settlement differences.
  
* Accuracy of the fixed asset register and completion of physical counts.
  
* Accuracy and timely release of prepayments.
  
* On-time preparation and submission of KPMG AUP reports to landlords.
  
* Quality and timeliness of month-end reconciliations and audit support.
  

**Key Relationships:**

  
  

  
* UAE Finance and Accounting
  
* Retail Operations and Store Management
  
* Treasury and Real Estate
  
* FP&A and Internal Controls
  
* KPMG, landlords, banks, payment service providers and external auditors
  

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

  
  

  
* Strong understanding of general ledger accounting, retail reconciliation, fixed assets and prepayments.
  
* Good knowledge of IFRS and financial control principles.
  
* Strong analytical skills with attention to detail and the ability to investigate high-volume reconciliation differences.
  
* Ability to manage daily operational deadlines, month-end close, audits and contractual landlord reporting.
  
* Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills.
  

**IT skills:**

  
  

  
* Outlook: intermediate
  
* Word: intermediate
  
* Excel: advanced
  
* PowerPoint: basic
  
* SAP: basic/intermediate experience is preferred.
  

**Language skills:**

  
  

  
* English: fluent written and verbal
  

**Requisite Education and Experience / Minimum Qualifications:**

  
  

  
* University degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce or Business Administration.
  
* Minimum 2 years of relevant accounting experience, preferably in retail, consumer goods or a multinational environment.
  
* Hands-on experience in account reconciliations and month-end closing; fixed asset and prepayment experience is strongly preferred.
  
* ACCA, CA, CPA or CMA qualification, or active progress toward one, is an advantage.
  
* Experience coordinating with key business stakeholders, audit or agreed-upon procedures requests is preferred.

jobs.title: Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Manager
jobs.description:
Canadian University Dubai (CUD) is seeking a highly analytical and experienced **Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Manager** to join its Finance Department. The successful candidate will lead the University's financial planning, budgeting, forecasting and performance reporting activities, providing strategic financial insights to support informed decision-making and long-term financial sustainability.

  

Reporting directly to the Finance Director, the FP&A Manager will work closely with academic and administrative leadership to translate enrolment trends, tuition revenue, staffing requirements and operational activities into reliable financial forecasts and actionable recommendations.

  

**Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting or a closely related discipline.
* Professional qualifications such as CPA, CMA, ACCA or equivalent are preferred.
* Strong expertise in financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling and management reporting.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI and other financial reporting and analytical tools.
* Demonstrated expertise in the use and deployment of Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools for financial analysis, forecasting, automation and decision support.
* Experience working with Oracle ERP systems and developing financial dashboards.
* Strong understanding of financial controls, budget management and financial performance analysis.

**Experience Requirements**

  

* Minimum of **5 to 8 years of relevant professional experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)**, including substantial experience in budgeting, forecasting and financial reporting.
* Proven experience developing and maintaining financial models, including driver-based forecasting and scenario analysis.
* Demonstrated experience managing annual budgets, multiyear financial plans and financial performance reporting.
* Experience producing management reports, financial dashboards and executive presentations to support strategic and operational decisions.
* Experience collaborating with senior management and departmental budget owners to evaluate financial performance and optimise resource allocation.
* Experience in the higher education sector is preferred, particularly in enrolment forecasting, tuition revenue analysis and academic cost planning.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Financial Planning and Budgeting**

  

* Lead the preparation and coordination of the University's annual operating budget, periodic forecasts and multiyear financial plans.
* Establish budgeting timelines, financial planning assumptions, reporting templates and forecasting methodologies in collaboration with the Finance Director and relevant departments.
* Partner with School Deans and administrative departments to assess staffing requirements, teaching costs, operating expenditure and capital investment proposals.
* Develop comprehensive tuition revenue and enrolment forecasts incorporating student intake, retention, withdrawals, credit hours, tuition fees, scholarships and discounts.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimisation, resource allocation improvements and financial efficiency.

**Financial Analysis and Performance Reporting**

  

* Prepare monthly and semester financial performance reports, including actual versus budget analysis, forecasts and explanations of significant variances.
* Develop and maintain financial dashboards and key performance indicators to monitor institutional financial and operational performance.
* Collaborate with Finance, Registrar, Student Accounts and Institutional Research and Planning to validate financial and academic data.
* Analyse financial trends, identify emerging risks and opportunities, and recommend corrective actions to improve performance.
* Prepare financial reports, presentations and recommendations for the Finance Director, University President and Finance Committee.

**Strategic Financial Decision Support**

  

* Conduct financial feasibility assessments and develop business cases for new academic programmes, programme expansion, tuition adjustments, scholarship initiatives and capital investments.
* Perform financial modelling, break-even analysis, scenario planning and sensitivity assessments to support institutional decision-making.
* Evaluate the financial implications of staffing proposals, operational initiatives and strategic investments.
* Provide forecasting inputs to support cash flow planning, including anticipated tuition collections and major expenditure commitments.

**Budget Control and Process Improvement**

  

* Monitor departmental expenditure, financial commitments and budget utilisation to support effective financial control.
* Assess budget transfers, unbudgeted expenditure requests and financial adjustments in accordance with the University's approval framework.
* Maintain robust financial models, documented planning assumptions, version controls and reporting procedures.
* Collaborate with Finance and ICT to enhance Oracle ERP reporting capabilities, automate financial processes and improve data accuracy.
* Leverage AI-powered analytical tools and business intelligence solutions to improve forecasting accuracy, reporting efficiency and financial insights.
* Supervise and support the FP&A Analyst, ensuring timely delivery of accurate financial analysis and reporting.

**Core Competencies**

  

* Excellent financial modelling, quantitative analysis and problem-solving capabilities.
* Strong commercial and financial judgement with the ability to translate complex data into practical recommendations.
* Advanced analytical and data validation skills, with a strong commitment to accuracy and financial integrity.
* Strategic thinking and the ability to connect financial performance with institutional objectives.
* Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and reporting deadlines.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, particularly when engaging with senior leadership and non-financial stakeholders.
* Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills across academic and administrative functions.
* Proactive approach to innovation, process improvement and the adoption of AI and digital financial solutions.
* High standards of professional integrity, confidentiality and accountability.

**About Canadian University Dubai**

  

Established in 2006, Canadian University Dubai is a leading higher education institution in the UAE, offering a Canadian-inspired education within a diverse and multicultural academic environment.

  

Located in Dubai's City Walk district, CUD provides a modern campus environment that promotes academic excellence, innovation, professional development and collaboration.

  

CUD offers a dynamic and inclusive workplace where employees can contribute to the University's continued development while advancing their professional careers.

  
  

Established in 2006, CUD is one of the most promising universities in the Middle East, Africa, and South Asian region, ***QS Ranked in the top 2% of Universities in the World, the******#1 University in Dubai,******and 21st in the Arab Region*** according to the QS Arab Region Rankings 2025.

  

Our expanded City Walk campus hosts state-of-the-art amenities with a focus on entrepreneurship, innovation, and creativity. Combining all the essential elements of technology, the avant-garde campus brings a new experience to students, featuring: laboratories, research facilities, media studios, high-tech classrooms, a multipurpose theatre, gymnasium, student centre, plenty of dining and entertainment options, and many more!

  

With the world’s fastest growing population, Dubai is home to an exciting, diverse, multi-cultural blend of young, dynamic, professionals, all drawn to the Emirate for its unrivalled lifestyle and the outstanding employment prospects.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant
jobs.description:
We offer you an Ocean of Possibilities. Join our family.

  

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

  

Position Title: Senior Accountant

  

Department: Finance

  

Location: Damen Middle East Shared Services, Abu Dhabi

  

Reports To: Finance Manager and Executive Director

  

Employment Type: Full-Time

  

**Role Purpose**

  

As a **Senior Accountant**, you will be responsible for managing the organization's accounting operations, ensuring accurate financial records, timely reporting, and compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements. You will support financial planning and decision-making through effective cash flow management, reconciliations, month-end close activities, audit coordination, and financial analysis. Working closely with internal stakeholders and external partners, you will contribute to process improvements, strengthen financial controls, and help drive operational excellence across the finance function.

  

**Key Accountabilities**

  

**Financial Operations**

  

* Manage day-to-day accounting activities, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger maintenance and payment processing, ensuring the accuracy, completeness and compliance of financial transactions with company policies.
* Monitor and reconcile bank accounts, credit card transactions, accruals, prepayments, fixed assets and other balance sheet accounts, ensuring accuracy and completeness of financial records and supporting documentation.
* Support purchase order management, vendor payments, and invoice processing activities.
* Handle payroll accounting, including payroll journal entries, reconciliations and related employee cost allocations, ensuring accurate and timely recording in the accounting records.
* Prepare and coordinate payment batches, ensuring compliance with the established approval matrix and internal payment controls.

* Manage intercompany accounting, including reconciliation of balances, cost allocations and recharges between group entities.

**Financial Reporting & Month-End Close**

  

* Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities.
* Prepare financial schedules, reconciliations, and management reports, and assist with the preparation of statutory financial statements, ensuring accuracy and compliance with applicable accounting standards and local regulatory requirements.
* Monitor outstanding receivables and payables, following up with stakeholders to ensure timely resolution.
* Assist with budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities.
* Contribute to group reporting and consolidation requirements.

**Cash Flow & Treasury Management**

  

* Prepare and maintain cash flow forecasts to support business planning and decision-making.
* Monitor cash movements, liquidity requirements, and payment obligations.
* Coordinate banking activities and maintain strong relationships with banking partners.

**Audit & Compliance**

  

* Support internal and external audits by providing required documentation and explanations.
* Assist with the implementation of new financial and reporting requirements as needed.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, internal controls and regulatory requirements, including UAE VAT and Corporate Tax obligations, coordinating with relevant internal and external stakeholders as required.

**Process Improvement**

  

* Identify and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to enhance accounting processes, internal controls and reporting efficiency.
* Support system enhancements, automation initiatives, and finance-related projects.
* Ensure adherence to agreed service level agreements (SLAs), internal procedures and established finance processes when delivering services to supported entities.

**Qualifications & Experience**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
* Professional qualification (ACCA, CPA, CA, CMA, or equivalent) preferred.
* Minimum 5–7 years of progressive accounting and finance experience, preferably within a multinational organisation or shared services environment, with experience in multi-entity and intercompany accounting and reporting.
* Strong knowledge of financial reporting, treasury management, month-end closing processes, audits and ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics or SAP.
* Excellent analytical, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

**Competencies**

  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Effective planning, organization, and prioritization abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
* Strong collaboration and teamwork mindset.
* Proactive, adaptable, and solution-oriented approach.
* Professional integrity and commitment to confidentiality.
